title: Research Culture Project Manager
description:
The Faculty of Medicine is seeking a highly organised manager in support of the Research Excellence Framework (REF) 2029 submission, critical in showcasing the Faculty’s multi-faceted and interdisciplinary world-leading research.The role provides oversight of the Research Culture activities and supports REF preparation activities across the Faculty, ensuring alignment with institutional REF guidance and processes in managing timelines, monitoring progress, assembling and presenting robust evidence, and reporting regularly to senior stakeholders.Experience of REF and/or the HE sector is desirable, but we welcome applicants with transferrable skills.Alongside REF responsibilities, the successful candidate will oversee the implementation of the Faculty of Medicine Research Culture strategy, including: leading on the implementation and ongoing monitoring of the Faculty’s Research Culture Action Plan, identifying strategic opportunities to enhance research culture and the research environment, developing and implementing evidence-based initiatives, and aligning all of these initiatives with institutional and external frameworks. The post holder will also support the Faculty’s People, Culture and Environment Working Group.The role requires excellent project management, analytical and communication skills. The successful candidate will also have the ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders, and contribute meaningfully to decision-making at a senior level.The University of Southampton provides a friendly, supportive environment for staff. Situated within one of the UK’s leading research-intensive Universities, the Faculty of Medicine is committed to fostering an inclusive research culture and an interdisciplinary approach to delivering world-leading research.This is a hybrid role with up to 2 days per week onsite. It can be worked across 4 or 5 days, depending on candidate preference.Queries regarding this post are very welcome, you can contact the hiring manager Olga Llewellyn on o.llewellyn@soton.ac.uk

title: Transformation Project Manager
description:
Job summary
Turn transformation plans into action
We are looking for a proactive and experienced 
Band 7 Transformation Project Manager
 to join our Transformation Team in a new role created to strengthen our delivery capacity.
You will lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple transformation and improvement projects and workstreams, working alongside clinical, operational and corporate teams to turn agreed priorities into practical, sustainable change.
This is a hands-on delivery role. You will drive progress, maintain momentum, constructively challenge where delivery is slipping and ensure clear ownership of milestones, actions, risks and benefits.
The role will support service redesign, productivity, efficiency and Cost Improvement Programme (CIP) delivery, with a focus on achieving measurable improvements for patients, services and the organisation.
Regular onsite presence will be essential, enabling you to work directly with teams, understand operational challenges and actively support delivery.
Main duties of the job
What you will be doing
You will:
Lead assigned projects and workstreams from initiation through to implementation and benefits realisation.
Develop and maintain clear project plans, milestones, risks, dependencies and delivery controls.
Drive progress and maintain momentum, identifying barriers, following through actions and escalating issues where needed.
Work alongside clinical and operational teams to redesign services and improve pathways, productivity and performance.
Support the delivery of transformation, efficiency and CIP schemes, ensuring projects have clear, measurable outcomes.
Use operational, financial, clinical and benchmarking information to identify opportunities and monitor impact.
Build strong relationships across services, bringing the right people together to turn plans into action.
Facilitate workshops and improvement activity, providing constructive challenge and practical delivery support.
Provide clear governance, reporting and escalation, ensuring progress, risks and benefits remain visible.
We are looking for someone who enjoys being close to delivery, creates structure in a complex environment and takes ownership for moving projects forward.
About us
Croydon Health Services NHS Trust provide hospital and community services from a number of community and specialist clinics throughout Croydon.
These include:o Croydon University Hospitalo Purley Hospitalo The Sickle Cell and Thalassaemia Centre in Thornton Heatho Community bases at Purley, Sanderstead, New Addington, Broad Green, Woodsideo A minor injuries unit in New AddingtonThe Trust was formed on 1st August 2010 through the integration of Croydon Community Health Services and Mayday Healthcare NHS Trust. Around 3,500 staff provide services for a population of over 360,000 people who are relatively young with a high level of ethnic diversity.Our Vision:"Excellent integrated care for you and your family, when and where you need it"Our 5 key 'Here for you' promises to the people of Croydon are:o You feel cared for by helpful and welcoming staffo You feel in safe hands with highly professional staffo You feel confident in your treatment from skilled teams of compassionate clinicianso You feel we value your time with convenient appointments, minimal waiting and care closer to homeo You feel it's getting better all the time as we continue to improve our services
We are one of 17 Trusts in the country who have been accepted as national pioneers on staff engagement and empowerment, through the adoption of "Listening into Action" as a new way of working. The approach we are taking to "Listening into Action" is new and different.

Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

 Key Account Director - Defence 
 London Victoria - Onsite

With a suite of products ranging from complex FX risk management and supplier payment financing to integrated API solutions, we are the strategic engine behind some of the world’s most ambitious firms.
 The Role 
 As a Key Account Director for Defence, you will lead the charge in this high-stakes vertical, navigating C-suite relationships to deliver sophisticated treasury and hedging solutions. The Defence industry operates on long-term cycles, massive capital outlays, and intricate global supply chains and your approach should reflect this. You aren't just hitting targets—you are a role model on our London floor, mentoring the next generation of talent and setting the gold standard for how Ebury dominates the market. 
 Responsibilities: 
• Strategic Origination: Identify and onboard Tier-1 prospects within the Defence and Aerospace sectors.
• Solution Architecting: Move beyond "spot trades." You will sell complex FX hedging strategies, cash management, and supplier payment financing solutions tailored to long-cycle defense contracts.
• C-Suite Navigation: Build and leverage high-level relationships with CFOs, Treasurers, and Finance Directors, understanding their specific budgeting and risk appetite.
• Sector Advocacy: Act as the internal "Defence Expert," providing feedback to Product teams to ensure Ebury’s roadmap remains the best-in-class for this sector.
• Excellence in Execution: Maintain a rigorous pipeline via Salesforce, ensuring a culture of data-driven sales and superior relationship management.
 Why Ebury? 
• Market-Leading Rewards: A competitive base salary with a transparent, uncapped commission structure designed for high-achievers.
• Next-Gen Tech: Access to an advanced product suite, including our proprietary API integrations and multi-currency platforms.
• Global Mobility: Opportunities for international bootcamps and visiting one of our global offices.
• Fast-Track Leadership: A clear growth pathway from individual contributor to a partner in the business.
• Work from our flagship, modern office in London Victoria.
 You... 
• Understand Defense: You can speak the language of "fixed-price bids," "long-term procurement," and "sovereign risk."
• Are a Master Negotiator: You thrive in high-value negotiations and can articulate complex financial concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Are a Culture Carrier: You lead by example, fostering a competitive yet collaborative environment on the sales floor.
• Speak Fluent English (a second language is a bonus).
 Feel free to reach out directly on LinkedIn - Freddie Mugridge
 #LI-DNP
 About us 
 Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally. 
 Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team. 
 At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage. 
 The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.
 We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.
 Important Security Notice for Job Applicants:
 Ebury only accepts applications via official Ebury channels. We will only contact you from an @ ebury.com domain. Always check the emails you receive from us, and note that we will never request payment for any part of the recruitment process. Stay safe and report suspicious activity.
 Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:
 Ebury does not accept unsolicited resumes, CVs, or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies or search firms without signed written Ebury recruitment terms in place for a specific role. Any unsolicited applications will be considered the sole property of Ebury. Ebury will not be responsible or liable for any placement fees or costs associated with unagreed candidate submissions or subsequent hires.

 Ebury uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automated tools to help streamline certain parts of our recruitment process, however, these tools are strictly for administrative efficiency. All hiring decisions, including application reviews, shortlisting, and final selections are evaluated and conducted by human talent acquisition professionals and hiring managers.

description: Our StoryHello there. We’re Zopa.We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. title: Technology Programme Manager
description:
About UsPlanet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide.In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence.With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions.Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.Role OverviewThe Technology Programme Manager owns the end-to-end delivery of complex, strategic technology programmes, with InfoSecurity as the primary initial focus. Working through a matrix structure, the role brings multiple projects, project managers and cross-functional teams together around clear outcomes, priorities and decisions. The Programme Manager is accountable for maintaining momentum, resolving barriers and driving the programme through to successful conclusion, while remaining available to lead programmes across other technology areas as priorities evolve.What You Will Do Own the full scope and lifecycle of assigned technology programme, translating strategic objectives into an integrated roadmap, delivery plan, outcomes and measurable success criteria. Lead delivery through a matrix structure, directly managing projects where required and coordinating or guiding project managers, workstream leads, technology teams and external partners. Maintain a programme-wide view of milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks, issues and benefits, intervening early to protect outcomes and momentum. Provide clear, decision-ready reporting to the Executive Leadership Team and senior stakeholders, with transparent status, options, recommendations and required actions. Prepare and lead effective steering committees focused on outcomes, priority decisions, trade-offs and timely resolution of escalated issues. Manage competing priorities and constraints, facilitating decisions on sequencing, capacity, scope and risk while maintaining alignment to enterprise objectives. Build strong partnerships across InfoSecurity, Technology, Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance and other functions, creating shared accountability for outcomes.Who You Are An experienced Technology Programme Manager with a strong record of owning complex, multi-project programmes and delivering measurable outcomes in fast-moving, regulated environments. Highly effective at leading through influence in matrix organisations and creating clarity, accountability and pace without relying on direct reporting lines. A confident executive communicator who prepares high-quality steering materials, presents to ELT-level stakeholders and turns complexity into clear decisions and actions. Skilled in programme governance, integrated planning, dependency management, financial oversight, risk and issue management, benefits tracking and prioritisation. A decisive, outcome-focused leader who takes ownership, challenges constructively and drives work through ambiguity to conclusion. Existing InfoSecurity or Cyber Security experience is highly desirable, with a strong interest in continuing to build technology and security knowledge. Comfortable applying strong programme leadership across InfoSecurity initially and other technology domains as priorities develop; payments or regulated-industry experience is advantageous.Why PlanetPlanet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce. We would love to hear from you – Apply now.At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

title: Programme Manager
description:
We are looking for a Programme Manager, Vehicle Programmes to run one of our low-volume, high-performance vehicle programmes, taking it from concept through development and homologation to start of production.Reporting to the Head of Programmes, you'll be the person who brings engineering, purchasing, manufacturing, quality and certification together. You'll make sure the car lands on its cost, weight, quality and timing targets, so the low mass, driving perfection and engineering art our cars stand for make it all the way to production.This is an exciting opportunity to own a whole vehicle programme. The plan, the budget and the risks are yours, from the first concept to the moment production starts.Key ResponsibilitiesYou will run the programme day to day, working closely with engineering, purchasing, manufacturing, quality and certification, and reporting to the Head of Programmes and senior leadership.This is your chance to:Lead a low-volume, high-performance vehicle programme from concept through development and homologation to start of production, owning its plan, budget and risks.Unite engineering, purchasing, manufacturing, quality and certification so the car meets its cost, weight, quality and timing targets.Build the integrated programme plan, with its milestones and gateway reviews, and keep it current in 3DEXPERIENCE so everyone works from the same picture.Track progress, budget and resources, so you always know where the programme really stands.Report status, risks and decisions to the Head of Programmes and senior leadership in a way people can act on.Own the risk and issue registers, push mitigations through and raise the alarm early when timing or cost starts to slip.Control engineering change so everyone can see what each change does to cost, weight and timing.Coordinate prototype and development vehicle builds, test plans and sign-offs.Drive homologation for the EU, UK, US and other markets with Certification, keeping it firmly on the critical path.Manage supplier timing and deliverables with Purchasing, including tooling and part readiness.Chair programme meetings and keep a clear record of actions and decisions.Ensure compliance with Health & Safety Policy requirements within your areas of responsibility.Skills, Knowledge and ExpertiseYou'll be an experienced programme manager with a solid understanding of how vehicles are developed and the confidence to keep a cross-functional team on track.EssentialExperience running vehicle programmes or other complex engineering programmes, ideally in automotive, motorsport or aerospace.A good grasp of how a vehicle is developed, from concept through validation and homologation to launch.Strong planning, budgeting and risk management skills.Hands-on use of a PLM or planning tool (3DEXPERIENCE or similar).An engineering degree or equivalent experience.The confidence to challenge people constructively and hold teams across functions to what they've committed to.Happy working in a small team that moves quickly, where you'll roll your sleeves up.DesirableAPM or PRINCE2.Why This Role MattersThis role puts you at the centre of a vehicle programme. You'll be responsible for getting a low-volume, high-performance car from concept to start of production, with the plan, the budget and the risks in your hands.You'll influence whether the car lands on its cost, weight, quality and timing targets. You'll also shape how engineering change, supplier readiness and homologation for the EU, UK, US and other markets come together on the critical path.Your leadership will help deliver Gordon Murray Group's uncompromising approach to driving perfection, low mass and engineering art.

About UsVisa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.Job DescriptionWhat's it all about?Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful and financial results for Visa’s network clients, including both financial services and merchants. Drawing on our expertise in strategy consulting, data analytics, brand management, marketing, operational and macroeconomics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients.VCA Implementation Services (VIS) is an augmentation of Visa’s consultancy offering, supporting the execution and implementation of recommendations to help scale competitive advantage and operate to succeed in the digital age.We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to work with some of Visa's leading clients.  You will be responsible for the successful execution of technical implementations of Visa-related projects across our UK&I clients. Working closely with both client and Visa personnel, the Programme Lead will have accountability for ensuring the delivered project outcomes are aligned against both the clients and Visa’s objectives across all aspects of delivery, including defining the requirements, scoping, training, migration/implementation, project planning, risk management, project controls, and stakeholder management (e.g. programme management, stakeholder engagement, programmed governance etc) ensuring that industry best practice is utilized in the design and execution of deliverables.What We Expect Of You, Day To DayProvide high level visibility and drive strategic initiatives for client engagements, reporting progress into UK&I VCA and VIS functions, maintaining governance and oversight.Lead deployed Visa teams and project manage the delivery strategies of developed solutions with a true entrepreneurial spirit. Ensure collaboration and overall integration between programme tracks.Design teams and source the technical expertise required to deliver high quality engagements with our clients.Proactively manage expectations and be the first line of escalation for our client partners and stakeholders on active VIS engagements.Understand our clients’ business objectives, needs, plans, etc. together with the UK&I Account Management Team.Identify opportunities and improvements to grow the business of both Visa and the client.Develop and propose appropriate project approaches and technical solutions to the client with compelling business cases.Provide Thought Leadership knowledge regarding the future of PayTech and retail banking to our client.Leverage Visa’s innovation, product and data capabilities to further grow our clients’ business by working together with the VCA and product teams.Build and retain Visa Consulting relationships with our key client stakeholders.Track funding consumption on all active projects you are leading.Capture learnings and create case studies to continually evolve the VIS practice.Develop an excellent understanding of Visa products and services.This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.QualificationsWhat we're after:EssentialProven experience in leading technical teams on product feature end-to-end delivery.Consistent track record of successful project management delivery, working across a range of teams.Strong consulting background, with the ability to develop and build strong, trusted client relationships and influence the design and outcomes of client engagements.Solid understanding of delivery techniques, methodologies, and best practices. Hands-on experience with Waterfall and Agile frameworks (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).Substantial experience in retail banking and/or payment card industry and/or merchant retail business desirable.Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with an ability to measure the financial impact to a client and demonstrate the value that a VIS engagement brings to both the client and Visa.Growth mindset that embraces creativity, optimism, and failing-fast. Comprehensive knowledge of tools and the use of data insights for business growth in a digital and technology-driven environment.Excellent storyteller, conveying interpretation of evidence and analysis against strategic objectives resulting in explicit recommended actions.High levels of integrity and business ethics.Willingness to maintain professional development.DesirableExperience in technical consulting sales.Strong understanding of payments with in-depth knowledge of areas such as virtual card payments, value-added solutions for corporates, payment tokenization, issuer processing platforms/providers, modern API concepts, technical integration, and file delivery.Demonstrated ability to write clean code in SQL and Python, C# or Java with accompanying knowledge of their industry-standard libraries and frameworks.Thought leader with the ability to guide, influence, and inspire performance across the technical development landscape.Visa is an EEO EmployerQualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: WRMP Strategy and Planning Manager
description:
Water is one of the UK’s most precious resources, and how we plan for the future has never been more important. This is a unique opportunity to take a leading role in shaping Thames Water’s long-term water resources strategy, helping to ensure a resilient water supply for millions of customers while navigating some of the industry's most complex regulatory and environmental challenges. As our WRMP Strategy and Planning Manager, you’ll lead programme coordination, influence strategic decision-making, and work with senior stakeholders across the business, regulatory bodies, and industry partners to deliver our future Water Resources Management Plans.What you'll be doing as a WRMP Strategy and Planning ManagerAs our WRMP Strategy and Planning Manager, you'll provide leadership across the planning, governance and delivery of Thames Water's Water Resources Management Plan programme, ensuring technical workstreams remain aligned, risks are managed, and regulatory commitments are successfully delivered. You'll be at the heart of strategic planning activities, working across multiple disciplines to drive outcomes that will shape the future of water resources across our region.Lead the coordination and delivery of Water Resources Management Plan activities and associated regulatory submissions.Provide oversight, challenge and assurance across technical planning workstreams, consultants and key stakeholders.Build strong relationships with regulators, regional planning groups and industry partners.Manage programme risks, dependencies and critical milestones to ensure successful delivery.Lead and develop a small team, creating a collaborative and high-performing environment.Drive continuous improvement across planning processes, governance and ways of working.Base location: Clearwater Court, Reading (Hybrid)Working pattern: 36 hours per week, with office attendance typically required on Tuesdays and Thursdays.What you should bring to the roleThe must-haves (essential criteria) for this opportunity include:Demonstrable experience in UK water resources planning and a strong understanding of Water Resources Management Plan requirements and regulatory frameworks.Technical experience in at least one area of Water Resource Management Planning (E.g. Supply Forecasting, Demand forecasting, Demand Management)Experience working within, or closely supporting, a UK water company.Proven ability to lead or coordinate complex technical programmes with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage and influence across all levels of an organisation and external bodies.Line management experience and a passion for developing high-performing teams.Degree qualification in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience.Nice-to-haves that would make you stand out:Experience delivering or supporting statutory Water Resources Management Plans.Experience working with Water Resources South East (WRSE) or similar regional planning organisations.Knowledge of programme management tools such as Microsoft Project or Primavera P6.Experience using AI and emerging technologies to improve planning and programme delivery.Chartered status or working towards chartership in a relevant technical discipline.What's in it for you?This is a rare opportunity to influence one of the largest and most important water resources programmes in the UK. You'll work alongside senior leaders, regulators and industry experts, helping to shape the long-term future of water supply while leading a talented team through an exciting period of change and investment.In addition, you'll benefit from:Competitive salary between £62,215 to £75,000 per annum (based on experience).26 days holiday per year increasing to 30 with the length of service (plus bank holidays)Performance-related pay plan directly linked to company performance measures and targets.Generous Pension Scheme through AON.Private Medical Health CareAccess to lots of benefits to help you take care of you and your family’s health and wellbeing, and your finances – from annual health MOTs and access to physiotherapy and counselling, to Cycle to Work schemes, shopping vouchers and life assurance.Find out more about our benefits and perks (Please note different T&Cs apply if on secondment)

title: Partnership Manager
description:
payabl. empowers businesses to grow through payments innovation and banking services. Our ambition is to expand our strong portfolio of global financial services we provide to businesses and make them all available in one place on our platform we call payabl.one. As a licensed financial company with principal membership with card schemes, we specialize in global payments and providing businesses with multi-currency accounts.The Role Is AboutOur Partnerships Team is growing! We're seeking a driven a Partnership Manager to join our team. If you thrive in a commercial and fast-paced environment, are passionate about growing ecosystems, and want to help shape the future of fintech through innovative partnerships, this could be your next challenge. You’ll play a key role in acquiring and managing high-impact partners that enhance payabl.’s capabilities and market reach.What You Will DoPartner Acquisition & Development – Identify, evaluate, and onboard new partners including orchestration platforms, ISOs, PSPs, and technology providers.commercial Ownership – Negotiate partnership agreements, manage commercial models (incl. commissions), and ensure profitable collaboration.Relationship Management – Build and nurture long-term relationships with partners, acting as a trusted advisor and main point of contact.Integration Oversight – Collaborate with product and tech teams to ensure smooth technical integrations that unlock scalable solutions for our clients.Sales Enablement – Enable joint go-to-market efforts and support partner education through training sessions and product presentations.Market Expansion – Contribute to expanding our global footprint by aligning with regional partners and identifying new opportunities for growth.Industry Engagement – Represent payabl. at events, conferences, and partner meetings to promote our capabilities and strengthen visibility in the ecosystem.What We NeedFintech & Payments Professional - The Perks Of Being a Payabl.erFuture-Proof Your Finances: Once you’ve passed probation, we’ll kickstart your Provident Fund to secure your future. Shop & Save: Exclusive local discount card + tickets for exciting events like Beonix, basketball games, and more. Speak Like a Local: Join free Greek language classes, twice a week, open to all team members. Celebrate Together: We bring colleagues from all offices together for unforgettable company celebrations.Global Collaboration & Events: Opportunities to participate in international company events and initiatives, connecting with colleagues from all regions and contributing to a truly global community Our Hiring ProcessInitial Interview - Conducted by the Talent Acquisition team (30-40 min).Video Assessment - If selected, you will complete a short video assessment (max 30 mins) via our platform, answering a few questions designed to assess your communication, problem-solving, and attention to detail.In-Depth Discussion - A 1 hour interview with the Head of Partnership (Acquiring)Meet Our Leadership - Focused team fit, with participation from the Group Chief Growth Officer (Acquiring) and the Head of Talent AcquisitionLet's embark on a journey to redefine the landscape of payments together. title: Delivery Manager
description: At Smart, our mission is to transform retirement, savings and financial wellbeing, across all generations, around the world.THE ROLESmart Pension is seeking a Delivery Manager to take responsibility for a defined portfolio of change programmes and client implementations. The Delivery Manager will plan, coordinate and report on delivery across that portfolio, ensuring that committed milestones are met and that risks, issues and dependencies are identified and managed. The role spans internal change delivery and the implementation of the platform for clients.The role sits within the Delivery team and reports to the Head of Delivery. The successful candidate will be allocated a portfolio, typically comprising two to four workstreams or a group of client implementations. The balance between internal change and client implementation will vary according to organisational demand.Key ResponsibilitiesPlanning and running deliveryDevelop and maintain delivery plans for the allocated workstreams, covering scope, milestones, sequencing, dependencies and critical path, and ensure these remain current. Operate the delivery rhythm, including planning sessions, stand-ups, and retrospectives. Monitor progress against plan and identify variance at the earliest opportunity, supported by evidence. Maintain the risk, issue, assumption and dependency position across the portfolio, assign owners, track mitigating actions and escalate where appropriate. Remove impediments to delivery, including securing decisions and resolving contention for shared resource between teams. Operate change control, ensuring the impact of scope changes on schedule, cost and risk is assessed and formally agreed. Coordinate releases with Engineering and product, including completion of the required readiness criteria. Client Implementation Own the implementation plan for allocated clients, from initiation through go-live and hypercare. Manage the client-facing delivery relationship, including progress reporting, issue resolution and early notification of any change to agreed dates. Coordinate data migration activity with Migration team and client, including validation, reconciliation, rehearsal and cutover, and ensure rehearsal findings are addressed. Manage client-side obligations, securing the data, approvals and decisions on which the implementation depends. Establish go-live readiness, including entry criteria, cutover runbook, rollback provision, support arrangements and associated communications. Reporting and stakeholders Produce delivery reporting for the portfolio to the standard set by the Head of Delivery, drawn from a single source of truth. Provide an accurate assessment of delivery confidence, raising schedule risk while mitigation remains possible and setting out the available options. Prepare and run governance forums for the allocated workstreams, including presentation, decisions sought and subsequent actions. Maintain alignment across Product, Engineering, Operations and Client Solution on delivery scope and timing. Ability to secure and sustain commitments from colleagues outside the direct reporting line. Composure when managing competing priorities, and the professional judgement to communicate adverse delivery positions promptly. title: Sales Lead - Defence
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.
 If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.
 Sales Lead - Defence 
 London Victoria - Onsite 
 Ebury is a global FinTech powerhouse. We don’t just move money; we empower international businesses to trade without boundaries. With a suite of products ranging from complex FX risk management and supplier payment financing to integrated API solutions, we are the strategic engine behind some of the world’s most ambitious firms.
 The Role 
 As the Sales Lead for Defence, you will lead the charge in this high-stakes vertical, navigating C-suite relationships to deliver sophisticated treasury and hedging solutions. The Defence industry operates on long-term cycles, massive capital outlays, and intricate global supply chains and your approach should reflect this. You aren't just hitting targets—you are a role model on our London floor, mentoring the next generation of talent and setting the gold standard for how Ebury dominates the market. 
 Responsibilities: 
• Strategic Origination: Identify and onboard Tier-1 prospects within the Defence and Aerospace sectors.
• Solution Architecting: Move beyond "spot trades." You will sell complex FX hedging strategies, cash management, and supplier payment financing solutions tailored to long-cycle defense contracts.
• C-Suite Navigation: Build and leverage high-level relationships with CFOs, Treasurers, and Finance Directors, understanding their specific budgeting and risk appetite.
• Sector Advocacy: Act as the internal "Defence Expert," providing feedback to Product teams to ensure Ebury’s roadmap remains the best-in-class for this sector.
• Excellence in Execution: Maintain a rigorous pipeline via Salesforce, ensuring a culture of data-driven sales and superior relationship management.
 Why Ebury? 
• Market-Leading Rewards: A competitive base salary with a transparent, uncapped commission structure designed for high-achievers.
• Next-Gen Tech: Access to an advanced product suite, including our proprietary API integrations and multi-currency platforms.
• Global Mobility: Opportunities for international bootcamps and visiting one of our global offices.
• Fast-Track Leadership: A clear growth pathway from individual contributor to a partner in the business.
• Work from our flagship, modern office in London Victoria.
 You... 
• Understand Defense: You can speak the language of "fixed-price bids," "long-term procurement," and "sovereign risk."
• Are a Master Negotiator: You thrive in high-value negotiations and can articulate complex financial concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Are a Culture Carrier: You lead by example, fostering a competitive yet collaborative environment on the sales floor.
• Speak Fluent English (a second language is a bonus).
 Feel free to reach out directly on LinkedIn - Freddie Mugridge
 #LI-FM2
 #LI-ONSITE
 About us 
 Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally. 
 Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team. 
 At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage. 
 The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.
 We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.
 Important Security Notice for Job Applicants:
 Ebury only accepts applications via official Ebury channels. We will only contact you from an @ ebury.com domain. Always check the emails you receive from us, and note that we will never request payment for any part of the recruitment process. Stay safe and report suspicious activity.
 Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:
 Ebury does not accept unsolicited resumes, CVs, or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies or search firms without signed written Ebury recruitment terms in place for a specific role. Any unsolicited applications will be considered the sole property of Ebury. Ebury will not be responsible or liable for any placement fees or costs associated with unagreed candidate submissions or subsequent hires.
 AI Transparency Statement:
 Ebury uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automated tools to help streamline certain parts of our recruitment process, however, these tools are strictly for administrative efficiency. All hiring decisions, including application reviews, shortlisting, and final selections are evaluated and conducted by human talent acquisition professionals and hiring managers.

title: Account Executive, Quantitative Trading & Investing
description:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 As a Strategic Account Executive for quantitative firms at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team introducing our frontier AI platform to the world's leading quantitative hedge funds, systematic asset managers, market makers, and proprietary trading firms. You'll drive adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic, enterprise-scale deals with firms whose researchers, technologists, and traders are among the most technical users in financial services. You'll draw on your experience selling to quantitative firms to grow revenue while becoming a trusted advisor to your customers, helping them embed AI into quantitative research, software engineering, data, risk, and operations workflows, and uncovering its full range of capabilities. Working closely with Product and Marketing, you'll continuously sharpen our value proposition, sales motion, and market positioning for quantitative firms.
 This role suits someone energised by building a new category with customers who test every claim, often build their own technology, and set a high bar for performance, security, and protection of their intellectual property. You'll identify high-potential accounts and run the strategies to win and grow them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products in quantitative firms, you'll help these organisations unlock new capabilities while advancing the responsible development of AI.
 Key responsibilities 
• Own a book of strategic, high-value accounts across quantitative hedge funds, systematic asset managers, market makers, and proprietary trading firms, carrying and exceeding an individual revenue target
• Engage personally with C-level, research, and senior technical stakeholders (CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Heads of Quantitative Research, Heads of Engineering, Heads of Data/AI), building business cases and value narratives
• Lead accounts through technical evaluation and procurement, security, data governance, regulatory, and legal review, through to production deployment and expansion
• Identify and prioritize high-potential opportunities within your accounts, building and executing account plans that turn strategic relationships into committed revenue
• Expand adoption from engineering teams to quantitative researchers, data scientists, portfolio managers, traders, risk, and operations, including in firms where teams operate independently and keep their work separate
• Run a disciplined pipeline and forecasting cadence, with accurate deal inspection, clear next steps, and predictable execution across a high-value, usage-driven book of business
• Partner closely with Applied AI, Solutions Architecture, and Product to design solutions, support rigorous customer evaluations, prove value quickly, and translate the needs of quantitative firms (research, engineering, data, risk, operations) into product and roadmap input
• Codify winning use cases, proof points, and reference stories from your deals while respecting customer confidentiality, partnering with Marketing and Enablement to help scale them across the broader financial services motion
• Orchestrate cross-functional and partner motions with Customer Success, Legal, Partnerships, and cloud partners to deliver a seamless customer experience, and represent Anthropic as a visible, trusted voice with customers and at industry events
 Minimum qualifications 
• Enterprise sales experience with quantitative hedge funds, systematic asset managers, market makers, proprietary trading firms, or closely related buy-side or capital markets organizations
• A track record of carrying and exceeding quota in enterprise sales of technical, complex products (API-first platforms, cloud infrastructure, data/ML platforms, developer tools, or enterprise SaaS)
• Experience winning and growing strategic enterprise accounts, including building relationships with senior executives and technical decision-makers
• Operational rigor across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including balancing velocity with deal quality and forecasting accurately in fast-changing environments
• Ability to hold credible technical conversations with engineers, quantitative researchers, and technology leaders, and experience working effectively with solutions architects or applied AI teams
• Experience guiding customers through security, data governance, and legal review of technology purchases
• Clear written and verbal communication with audiences ranging from hands-on technical users to senior executives
• A genuine interest in deploying AI responsibly and motivation to advance Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI
 Preferred qualifications 
• Experience bringing generative AI or LLM-based products, or other emerging platform technologies, to quantitative investment or trading firms
• Working knowledge of how quantitative firms operate, such as the research lifecycle, backtesting, market and alternative data, execution, and risk, and how needs differ between market makers, systematic managers, and multi-strategy funds
• Familiarity with the technology environments common in quantitative firms, such as Python, C++, kdb+/q, large-scale data platforms, and high-performance computing
• Experience selling to customers with strong in-house engineering teams, including navigating build-versus-buy decisions and benchmark-driven evaluations
• Familiarity with the security and governance expectations of trading and investment firms, such as protection of proprietary research and code, information barriers, data retention, encryption key management, and audit
• Experience selling with and through cloud and ecosystem partners

title: Enablement Lead, Government
description:
About the Team

The Adoption, Innovation, and Transformation team within OpenAI for Government helps government organizations turn OpenAI products into durable capabilities and measurable mission impact.

We work alongside public servants to move from initial exploration to confident, responsible, organization-wide use of AI. Our work combines hands-on enablement, adoption strategy, deployment support, community, content, and practical transformation tailored to government missions and operating environments.

By translating the potential of OpenAI’s technology into better individual workflows, stronger teams, and improved public services, we help government customers deepen adoption, build lasting organizational capability, and spend more time on mission.

About the Role

The Enablement Lead, Government is a specialist role focused on delivering high-impact enablement and adoption services across OpenAI’s product suite. This role is responsible for designing and delivering experiences that support repeatable adoption frameworks, drive sustained activation, expand the breadth and depth of usage, and produce measurable value for government organizations.

This role sits at the intersection of enablement, education, adoption, community, content, and customer experience. It blends strong product fluency, instructional design, customer advisory, and a deep understanding of public service. You will lead live workshops, deliver enablement programs, and design adoption interventions for audiences ranging from front-line public servants and technical practitioners to senior government leaders.

You will be a trusted guide to government customers, helping them learn, share, teach, celebrate successes, and use AI confidently in their day-to-day work. You will help organizations understand not only what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to apply them safely and effectively while respecting their missions, operating environments, workforce needs, and responsibilities to the public.

Success in this role means accelerating customer confidence, increasing product adoption, supporting successful launches and deployments, and helping government organizations translate product capabilities into tangible mission outcomes. You will own outcomes related to activation and sustained usage while helping shape how OpenAI enables and supports public-sector customers at scale.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Travel and regular work from government customer sites are required.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the enablement of OpenAI products, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Agents, helping define effective patterns for responsible adoption across government organizations.

 - Lead government customers through the full enablement lifecycle, from initial onboarding and activation through expansion, optimization, and long-term adoption.

 - Define and manage structured enablement and deployment programs with clear goals, milestones, owners, and measures of success.

 - Design and deliver high-impact engagements—including onboarding sessions, advanced capability training, executive briefings, academies, hackathons, listening sessions, and hands-on mission or workflow labs—for audiences ranging from senior leaders to front-line staff.

 - Guide government leaders, champions, technical teams, and working teams through organizational change by building confidence, establishing effective habits, and translating product capabilities into practical workflows and mission outcomes.

 - Serve as a subject matter expert for designated products, roles, or government mission areas, building deep expertise and identifying emerging public-sector use cases for new product capabilities.

 - Develop government-specific learning journeys, training materials, playbooks, FAQs, demonstrations, use cases, customer impact stories, and communications that enable high-quality adoption programs to scale.

 - Provide timely education for product launches, new features, and capability rollouts, translating product updates into clear and practical relevance for government users.

 - Advise government customers on workforce communications and engagement strategies that build awareness, confidence, participation, and sustained use.

 - Build trusted relationships with government leaders, program owners, technical teams, champions, and front-line public servants, creating experiences that reflect an understanding of their constraints, motivations, and responsibilities to the public.

 - Support government customer communities, events, and peer-learning experiences by keeping resources, discussions, updates, and thought leadership useful and current.

 - Identify and amplify government champions, creative use cases, and meaningful customer outcomes that encourage responsible experimentation, recognize public servants’ contributions, and help other organizations learn.

 - Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Product, Global Affairs, Communications, Marketing, Readiness, and other teams to deliver cohesive experiences for public-sector customers.

 - Gather and synthesize government customer feedback, adoption signals, participation data, and engagement outcomes to improve enablement programs and bring the voice of public servants back to Product and other internal stakeholders.

 - Identify patterns across government customers and translate them into scalable programs, content, playbooks, and best practices without losing the human connection required to support public servants effectively.

Job summary
Capital Projects: Programme Manager - Band 8c
We are seeking an experienced Programme Manager to oversee the work of the strategic capital programme at Croydon Health Services NHS Trust. Likely projects include a New Endoscopy Unit, a Pharmacy Refurbishment and the development of a new Maternity Unit.
Reporting to the Deputy Director of Strategy and Capital Programmes
Main duties of the job
The post holder will:
Manage a portfolio of complex strategic estates projects, maintaining oversight of scope, programme, cost, quality, risk, dependencies, resources, governance and benefits.
Identify opportunities for estate rationalisation, investment, acquisition, disposal, redevelopment and partnership working.
Commission and manage external consultants, professional advisers and contractors, ensuring effective performance, appropriate use of resources and compliance with procurement requirements and Standing Financial Instructions.
Coordinate the preparation of strategic outline cases, business cases, funding submissions, board papers and approval documentation in accordance with NHS requirements and Trust governance.
Provisional Interview Date 14th & 15th December 2026

Croydon Health Services NHS Trust provides hospital and community services across Croydon through a range of clinics and specialist centres. Formed in August 2010 from the integration of Croydon Community Health Services and Mayday Healthcare NHS Trust, we employ around 4,100 staff serving a diverse population of over 360,000 people.
Our main site, Croydon University Hospital, is one of the busiest in London. We are also leading the way in delivering more healthcare in community settings and people's homes. Our district nursing teams, Allied Health Professionals and community matrons care for people of all ages across the borough.
Like the wider NHS, we are working hard to meet increasing demand. With the right people on board, we continue to innovate and transform our services to provide the highest quality care for local residents. We place strong emphasis on education, training and career development for all staff.
If you want to make a real difference, challenge yourself and be part of a Trust that's shaping local healthcare, Croydon Health Services could be the place for you.
At Croydon Health Services NHS Trust, we are committed to supporting flexible working arrangements. Applicants are encouraged to discuss any flexibility they may need during the recruitment process.

The Capital Programme Health and Safety Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all health, safety and regulatory compliance activities associated with the UKHSA Porton Capital Programme, ensuring the safe delivery of a diverse portfolio of capital projects within a live High Hazard Life Sciences environment.

Lead and oversee all health and safety and regulatory compliance activities associated with the UKHSA Porton Capital Programme.
Contain and control risk by enforcing health and safety procedures, maintaining compliance, and ensuring measures are in place to mitigate residual risk.

Communicate proactively and professionally with stakeholders at all levels.

title: Project Manager
description:
Job DescriptionAt CMDP+ we believe that people matter. We know that to build successful, creative teams we need a diverse workforce that can deliver new innovative ways of thinking. We provide an environment where you will have the freedom to develop and grow to your full potential.CMDP+ is looking to strengthen their Delivery team with a Construction and Delivery Lead / Project Manager for our Southern Water Framework. MWH Treatment and Costain Group are part of the CMDP+ joint venture that will deliver a range of construction schemes to maintain and improve Southern Water’s water supply and wastewater treatment works within the South and Southeast regions.The Joint Venture has been set up specifically to execute the 5-year (2025 – 2030) AMP8 capital delivery framework. We will be delivering a programme of works up to £1bn over the 5-year period consisting of both heavy civil engineering and mechanical and electrical activities.At Costain, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. If you’re passionate about making a positive impact and think you can bring value to our team, we’d love to hear from you—even if you don’t tick every box. Your unique skills and experiences could be exactly what we need.ResponsibilitiesManagement of Client interface meetings and reporting of progress/cost to the CMDP PM and Commercial Team representative. Manage, supervise, train and mentor the site teams to enable them to optimise their work contribution. Management of H&S and Quality data with the site team for reporting purposes. Review contractual agreements and develop working methods, programme and forecast costs with the Client, Contracts Manager and Specialist / Suppliers identifying any inaccuracies or inconsistencies.Manage and undertake internal project reviews Develop programmes and forecast budgets, assess actual programme and productivity achieved and review weekly, taking action where appropriate, and reporting any changes to the Contracts Manager and Commercial department. Be fully conversant with specialists’ contract conditions. Positively manage the programme to ensure the appropriate specialists provide the level of resources with the necessary skills so as not to impede the construction programme. Communicate with the Contracts Manager, site team and the commercial team’s issues of non-conformances and contractual correspondence. Ensure that comprehensive records of resources employed on additional works are maintained. Ensure that a full and accurate daily site diary is kept, including any changes / variations, specialists’ attendance, and records of work-related discussions with the design team /site team. Ensure that inspection and test plans, risk assessments and method statements for the control of the works are reviewed, approved and adhered to. Keep abreast of developments in professional field Adherence to Costain policies and procedures Supervising responsibility for site teams; liaison with internal and external stakeholders Be familiar with, and demonstrate commitment to the requirements of the Health & Safety and Environmental Policies Management of design partner(s) in the delivery of project specifications and deliverables. Responsible for the overall delivery of contracts within your allocated portfolioQualificationsDegree level qualification in a Civil Engineering allied subject or HND in Civil Engineering and vocational training in EngineeringUnderstanding of Engineering PrinciplesKnowledge and understanding of construction contract law and forms of contract through experience and formal training.Extensive technical knowledge of construction techniques and best practices.Computer competence (MS Word, Excel, Document control system, Primavera software). Relevant CSCS CardTraining in Health & Safety and Environmental managementCurrent Driving LicenceExperience of resource management and workforce efficiencyExperience of NEC3 or 4Desirable (the ideal)Water industry experienceDegree in Civil EngineeringMICEMAPMComputer competence Vocational Training (successful experience of project management)About UsCostain helps to improve people’s lives with integrated, leading edge, smart infrastructure solutions across the UK’s energy, water, transportation and defence markets. We help our clients improve their business performance by increasing capacity, improving customer service, safeguarding security, enhancing resilience, decarbonising and delivering increased efficiency. Our vision is to be the UK’s leading smart infrastructure solutions company. We will achieve this by focusing on blue chip clients whose major spending plans are underpinned by strategic national needs, regulatory commitments, legislation or essential performance requirements. We offer our clients leading edge solutions that are digitally optimised through the following five services which cover the whole lifecycle of their assets: future-shaping strategic consultancy; consultancy and advisory; digital technology solutions; asset optimisation and complex programme delivery. Our culture and values underpin everything we do.Costain appreciate the time and effort taken when applying for one of our positions but, due to the high volume of responses, we are unable to provide individual feedback on candidates at application phase.We do share individual feedback following an interview .A Disability Confident employer will generally offer an interview to any applicant that disclose they have a disability and meets the minimum criteria for the job as defined by the employer.It is important to note that in certain recruitment situations such as high-volume, seasonal and high-peak times, the employer may wish to limit the overall numbers of interviews offered to both disabled people and non-disabled people.For more details please go to the Disability Confident website:https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/disability-confident-campaign

title: Implementations Manager
description:
Role: Implementation ManagerLocation: London (Hybrid)Employment: FulltimeRole PurposeWe are looking for an experienced Implementation and Cut-Over Manager to lead the end-to-end deployment, data migration and cut-over strategy for a major public sector digital transformation programme.In this pivotal role, you will orchestrate the complex transition from a legacy Oracle core system to a modern Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) application suite, featuring a hybrid database architecture split across Azure Cosmos DB and Microsoft Dataverse. You will also coordinate the simultaneous re-platforming and integration of multiple Scala-based GDS (Government Digital Service) front-end channels, a brand-new integration layer, and downstream analytics and legislative reporting feeds.Your leadership will ensure seamless citizen-facing service continuity, zero critical data loss, full compliance with government legislative mandates, and alignment with the GDS Service Standard.Key Responsibilities Cut-Over Strategy & Master Planning Design, govern and execute the comprehensive Master Cut-Over Plan (MCP), encompassing minute-by-minute deployment schedules, blackout windows, go/no-go criteria and fallback procedures. Ensure all cut-over phases and readiness gates satisfy strict public sector audit requirements and align with the GDS Service Standard (supporting Alpha, Beta and Live transitions). Coordinate synchronised cut-over activities across multi-disciplinary squads, legacy system custodians, commercial vendors and external suppliers. Hybrid Data Migration & Dual-Store Governance Oversee the end-to-end data migration strategy, ensuring clean extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) from legacy Oracle to a split-persistence model: Microsoft Dataverse for relational business data and Azure Cosmos DB for high-throughput, scale-out storage. Establish robust data reconciliation frameworks, automated validation routines and audit trails to guarantee referential integrity and zero data loss. Plan and direct rigorous migration dry runs (Mock 1, Mock 2, Final Dress Rehearsal) to validate performance, pipeline throughput and execution timing within strict implementation windows. Multi-Channel Replatforming & Integration Orchestration Manage the simultaneous cut-over and re-routing of multiple Scala-based GDS public-facing channels, ensuring zero disruption to citizen interactions and maintaining strict API contracts. Supervise the deployment and priming of the new integration middleware tier (e.g. Azure Integration Services, API gateways, message queues) connecting front-end channels to the D365 core. Coordinate the cut-over of downstream data ingestion pipelines, data warehouses, and statutory and legislative government reporting feeds. Governance, Command Centre & Risk Management Lead structured Go/No-Go readiness reviews with Senior Responsible Owners (SROs), digital directors and technical leads, presenting defensible risk metrics. Establish and lead the Go-Live Command Centre (War Room) during the deployment weekend, managing real-time escalations and operational triage. Oversee the post-live hypercare stabilisation phase, tracking defect resolution and managing a smooth handover to permanent service operations.Key Requirements & Essential SkillsTechnical & Architecture Experience Senior experience as a Release, Implementation or Cut-Over Manager leading large-scale enterprise technology transformations. Deep, practical knowledge of migrations involving Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the wider Azure ecosystem, specifically Azure Cosmos DB and Microsoft Dataverse architectures. Familiarity with modern microservices, API-led connectivity and high-volume public sector digital channels (such as Scala-based GDS services). Proven track record of planning and executing complex, high-volume data migrations from legacy relational systems (e.g. Oracle).Public Sector & Compliance Competencies Extensive working knowledge of the UK Government Digital Service (GDS) Service Standard, Service Manual and Technology Code of Practice (TCoP). Experience navigating government spend controls, digital service assessments, and public sector security and data protection standards (UK GDPR, DPA 2018).Leadership & Soft Skills Exceptional crisis management: Calm, decisive and structured under intense pressure during critical go-live weekends. Outstanding stakeholder management: Equally comfortable bridging deep-dive technical engineering teams (Scala developers, D365 architects, DBAs) with non-technical policy makers, SROs and commercial suppliers. Strong risk identification and mitigation mindset: A history of building bulletproof contingency and rollback plans.

BSPS Transport Services is responsible for carrying out efficient and safe transportation of mail, laboratory samples, pharmacy, medical records and stores between hospital sites and other NHS organisations within the region.The responsibilities of the successful applicant will include strong support to the Head of Transport, comprehensive staff management throughout the employee life cycle including induction of new staff, training, objective setting and performance management.You should be reliable, have a responsible and flexible attitude with good organisational skills, and be resourceful, honest, with the commitment and ability to work on your own or as part of the team.You must have a full clean driving license and management experience at an appropriate level and or NVQ Level 3 qualifications. Hours will vary to meet the urgent demands of the business, but it is likely that the hours will be 08.30 to 17.00 in the first instance.The Trust operates a No Smoking policy on all sites and premises which includes work vehicles.As part of the management team to be responsible for the day to day running of Cody depot and the management of RSCH Depot, as well as assisting at other BSPS depots as required. title: Senior Operations Responder
description:
A BOUT TIDE 
 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
 Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.
 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
 Tide facts: 
• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
 ABOUT THE ROLE
 The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection & Response
 Product Security consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.
 Threat Detection & Response (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.
 Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.
 While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.
 As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don’t want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.
 When the security queue is empty, you’ll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.
 As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be: 
 Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus) 
• Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).
• Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.
• Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.
• Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.
 Scaling investigation through automation & Improving detection efficacy 
• Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the “anything is possible” mantra.
• Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team’s time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.
• Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.
• Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.
• Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.
 Building when the queue is clear 
• Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.
• Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.
• Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.
• Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.
• Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.
