title: Team Lead, Data Migration Services
description:
Retire the ERPAt Light, we’re on a mission to replace the ERP. Traditional systems are slow, painful to implement, and built for factories, not modern companies. Our Smart Financial Platform (SFP) is built for today’s global, service-based businesses, automating accounting, reporting and financial flows with speed and simplicity.In just a short time, we’ve gone from idea to powering operations for leading companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot. We build with our customers, ship at high velocity, and obsess over making finance software that people actually love to use.You’re joining an early-stage company defining a new software category, backed by top investors including Balderton, Atomico, Cherry Ventures, Seedcamp and Entrée Capital. Our advisory board includes the former CTO of Workday Financials, the Chief Architect of SAP S/4HANA, and SVPs from EY and Oracle. At Light, you’ll work with exceptional people, build category-defining products, and have the freedom to shape something transformative.The RoleOwn the data migration practice end to end: every customer moving to Light from Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage or spreadsheets goes through you and your team. Lead, coach and grow a small team of migration specialists, setting priorities across a pipeline of concurrent customer migrations and keeping go-live dates on track. Run migrations hands-on when it matters: extracting legacy data, mapping charts of accounts, business partners, open invoices and balances, and reconciling the result back to the source system. Build and maintain the source-system connectors and migration flows that power our Zero Day Implementation offering, so a new customer’s records can be converted into Light in hours, not weeks. Use AI and automation to speed up mapping, cleansing and reconciliation, and turn repeated manual work into productised, self-serve tooling with Engineering and Product. Set the standards: migration methodology, mapping templates, reconciliation checks, data quality rules, and clear scope boundaries (what we migrate, what we don’t, and what’s billable, such as historical documents and attachments). Be the expert voice with customers’ finance leaders on migration questions, including multi-entity, consolidation, FX and VAT treatment, and be clear with them when a request would put accuracy or timelines at risk. Support Sales and Solutions Engineering with migration scoping, effort estimates and sample migrations for prospects. Track and report on migration throughput, time to go-live and data accuracy, and use them to decide where to automate next. How You Fit Into The TeamAs Team Lead, Data Migration Services, you sit at the front door of every Light customer relationship. Implementation Managers own the customer journey; you own getting their history into Light accurately and fast. You’ll partner daily with Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering and Sales, and report directly to the Head of Services.This is a player-coach role: you’ll lead a small team and still roll up your sleeves on the hardest migrations and connector builds. Your biggest mandate is making “zero day conversion” real: run the records first, then run the processes.Your Qualifications Could BeYou have personally delivered at least one full accounting system migration through go-live and sign-off (for example Xero, QuickBooks, Sage or NetSuite into a new platform). This is a must. Around 5 years in ERP data migration, finance systems implementation or accounting technology, including some time leading people or a workstream. Hands-on experience with at least two of Xero, QuickBooks Online, NetSuite or Sage as a source system. Strong accounting fundamentals: you understand double entry, trial balances, AR/AP subledgers, multi-entity, multi-currency and UK VAT, and can reconcile to the penny. Technical depth to build, not just configure: comfortable with REST APIs, OAuth, SQL, and scripting (Python or TypeScript) for extraction and transformation. Practical, evidenced experience using AI tools to speed up data mapping, cleansing or migration work. Experience designing repeatable ETL processes, mapping templates and data validation checks. A clear, confident communicator with finance leaders, who can explain when a request isn’t sound and suggest a better way. Able to manage many concurrent migrations while keeping quality high, with the support of a team you’ll shape. If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person. Bonus PointsA background as an accountant, auditor or finance systems consultant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Experience building or maintaining integrations with accounting platform APIs (Xero, QBO, NetSuite SuiteTalk/SuiteQL). Exposure to IFRS, UK GAAP, consolidations, intercompany and revenue recognition. Experience at a SaaS or fintech company turning services work into product. Familiarity with workflow automation tools like n8n. The Good StuffIn addition to being part of a great team and working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer:💸 A competitive salary plus equity.🏝 A generous paid annual leave package, plus UK public holidays.🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you help shape a market-defining product.Light is an equal opportunity employer.Final WordsWorking at Light means you’re embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat code is that we’ve built something like this before, and now we’re doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.If you love clean data, hate month-long implementations, and want to build the team that makes switching to Light effortless, we’d love to hear from you at careers@light.inc.Join the rocket ship while it’s taking off 🚀
